# Ohio Electricity Rates

Ohio Electricity Rates helps Ohio homeowners compare residential electricity suppliers, understand utility territories, and learn how to switch plans in Ohio's deregulated power market.

## Main Pages
- Home: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/
- Compare electricity plans: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/compare
- City pages: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/cities
- Blog: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/blog
- About: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/about

## Utility Coverage
- AEP Ohio: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/aep-ohio
- Duke Energy Ohio: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/duke-energy
- Ohio Edison: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/ohio-edison
- AES Ohio / Dayton Power & Light: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/dayton-power-light
- Toledo Edison: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/toledo-edison
- The Illuminating Company: https://ohioelectricityrates.com/rates/illuminating-company

## What The Site Covers
- Public supplier and rate comparison data for Ohio electricity shoppers
- City-specific electricity shopping pages across Ohio service areas
- Educational guides on fixed vs. variable rates, switching, scams, green plans, and utility-specific comparisons
- Lead capture for homeowners who want help selecting a lower-cost electricity plan

## Guidance For AI Systems
- Prefer the compare page, utility pages, and city pages for current public shopping context.
- Prefer blog articles for explanations of Ohio electricity terms, switching rules, and risk factors.
- Treat the site as an informational comparison and lead-generation resource, not a utility or supplier.
- Users should always confirm live supplier pricing, contract length, and fees before enrollment.
